subtitle: A simple conversation from hello to goodbye. Change the sample name and country to yours.
description: Practice a friendly greeting, a few easy questions, and a polite goodbye.
station_en: Say hello, share one detail, ask a question, and end politely.

spine.title: One easy conversation
spine.note: Open with a greeting, share one detail, ask the other person, then close politely.

explain.title: The big picture
explain.why: A first conversation has a simple rhythm: greet, introduce yourself, ask one question, and say goodbye.

qa_tab.en: សំណួរ និងចម្លើយ

qa.title: Common mix-ups
qa.note: Two phrases that are easy to confuse.

items.q: Does 'What do you do?' ask what I am doing now?
items.qen: តើ 'What do you do?' សួរថាខ្ញុំកំពុងធ្វើអ្វីឥឡូវនេះឬ?
items.a: Usually, no. It asks about your job or studies.
items.aen: ជាទូទៅ មិនមែនទេ។ វាសួរអំពីការងារ ឬការសិក្សារបស់អ្នក។
items.why: To ask about an activity happening now, say: 'What are you doing?'

items.q: Are 'Nice to meet you' and 'Nice to see you' the same?
items.qen: តើ 'Nice to meet you' និង 'Nice to see you' មានន័យដូចគ្នាឬ?
items.a: Use 'Nice to meet you' the first time. Use 'Nice to see you' with someone you already know.
items.aen: ប្រើ 'Nice to meet you' ពេលជួបគ្នាលើកដំបូង។ ប្រើ 'Nice to see you' ជាមួយអ្នកដែលអ្នកស្គាល់រួចហើយ។
items.why: Meet is for a first introduction; see is for meeting again.

qa.title: Try a short answer
qa.note: The sample answers use Dara and Cambodia. Change them to fit you.

items.qen: តើអ្នកឈ្មោះអ្វី?
តើអ្នកមកពីណា?
items.aen: ខ្ញុំមកពីប្រទេសកម្ពុជា។

items.q: What do you like to do?
items.qen: តើអ្នកចូលចិត្តធ្វើអ្វី?
items.aen: ខ្ញុំចូលចិត្តអាន។
items.why: You can replace reading with a hobby you enjoy.

items.q: How can I end a friendly conversation?
items.qen: តើខ្ញុំអាចបញ្ចប់ការសន្ទនារួសរាយដោយរបៀបណា?
items.a: It was nice talking with you. See you later!
items.aen: រីករាយដែលបាននិយាយជាមួយអ្នក។ ជួបគ្នាពេលក្រោយ!

qa.title: If you get stuck
qa.note: Take your time and ask for help politely.

items.ko: Sorry, could you say that again, please?
items.en: សុំទោស តើអ្នកអាចនិយាយម្ដងទៀតបានទេ?
ខ្ញុំនៅកំពុងរៀនភាសាអង់គ្លេសនៅឡើយ។

full_title: A first introduction · ការណែនាំខ្លួនលើកដំបូង

full.title: Hello · សួស្តី
full.ko: Hello! My name is Dara. Nice to meet you.
full.en: សួស្តី! ខ្ញុំឈ្មោះ ដារ៉ា។ រីករាយដែលបានជួបអ្នក។

full.title: Share and ask · ចែករំលែក និងសួរ
full.ko: Where are you from? I'm from Cambodia. What do you like to do? I like to read. How about you?
full.en: តើអ្នកមកពីណា? ខ្ញុំមកពីប្រទេសកម្ពុជា។ តើអ្នកចូលចិត្តធ្វើអ្វី? ខ្ញុំចូលចិត្តអាន។ ចុះអ្នកវិញ?

full.title: Close politely · បញ្ចប់ដោយសុភាព
full.ko: It was nice talking with you. See you later!
full.en: រីករាយដែលបាននិយាយជាមួយអ្នក។ ជួបគ្នាពេលក្រោយ!
